Message:
“I wish I’d never been born.”
You can’t walk through the slums
without hearing those words.

I lost count of how many times
I thought that.
If the pain from this hunger
could all just go away...
maybe I should just...

That’s why,
when my little brother was born,
I felt no ounce of happiness.

I mean, how can I,
when living only
brings suffering...

Then, when my father
told me to go and throw
my little brother away,
I thought I had no other choice.

But, when I held him in my arms,
he looked up at me...and smiled.

The innocence of his smile
and his trusting eyes...

lit up the darkness
clouding my heart.

Then...I felt the tears
starting to pour out.

“I’m sorry...!
It’s okay now.
Your big sister’s here!”

As I cradled my tiny brother
in my arms,
I took one step forward,
and kept going.

He’s sick and won’t survive
on his own. So, I’ll be the
one to keep him safe.

Even if our time together
will be short,
I’ll at least make sure
he’s the happiest kid
in the whole wide world.
